定长与雪崩效应: Fixed output and the avalanche effect
SHA-256等固定输出哈希将许多可能输入映射到有限摘要空间，所以碰撞必然存在；: Hashes such as SHA-256 map many possible inputs into a finite digest space, so collisions must exist. Security requires practical difficulty finding preimages or collisions. Avalanche describes statistical output changes from small input changes; it alone does not prove security or guarantee exactly half the bits change every time.
密码存储应使用专门的密码哈希方案和独立随机盐，按实际硬件调参数。Argon2id: Use dedicated password hashing with independent random salts and parameters chosen for real hardware. Argon2id exposes memory and time costs; bcrypt primarily adjusts computational work. They are not the same class of memory-hard function. Guessing rates vary by algorithm, parameters and hardware, without fixed universal rates or speed ratios.
AES等对称算法可受益于专用指令，常用于批量数据；吞吐量依算法、模式、硬件和消息: Algorithms such as AES can benefit from dedicated instructions and suit bulk data. Throughput depends on algorithm, mode, hardware and message length. Not every public-key algorithm uses modular exponentiation or is a fixed thousand times slower. Use authenticated encryption from established libraries, following key and nonce requirements instead of encrypting without integrity.
共享密钥可以预先配置，也可通过经认证的密钥协商等方式建立。单独的Diffie-H: Keys may be preconfigured or established through authenticated agreement. Diffie–Hellman alone does not authenticate peers; authentication prevents man-in-the-middle substitution. Common TLS 1.3 certificate handshakes combine signature authentication with ephemeral agreement and also support PSK paths. They do not all encrypt and transmit a session key using a public key.
公钥加密使用加密和解密方案；数字签名使用签名和验证方案，两者目标与编码要求不同。: Public-key encryption uses encryption/decryption schemes; signatures use signing/verification schemes, with different objectives and encodings. Even with RSA, signing is not private-key encryption. ECDSA and EdDSA are signature algorithms, not encryption operations run backward. Distinguish key purposes through protocol and library interfaces.
为什么不干脆只用它: Why not use public-key encryption for everything?
例如RSA-OAEP能加密的消息长度受密钥及哈希参数限制。混合方案可用公钥机制建: RSA-OAEP, for example, limits message length according to key and hash parameters. Hybrid designs can establish or encapsulate a key through public-key mechanisms, then encrypt the body symmetrically with authentication. Key agreement can also derive it. TLS 1.3 does not use old RSA key transport; not every protocol is RSA-encrypted symmetric keys.
数字签名并不隐藏消息，验签成功也不说明内容本身诚实、合法或没有恶意。验证者还要确: A signature neither conceals content nor proves that it is honest, lawful or benign. Verify that the public key belongs to the intended party, algorithms and parameters are appropriate, and key status is trusted. Cryptographic verification is not automatically real-world identity proof or unconditional non-repudiation.
摘要和编码由方案规定: The scheme defines hashing and encoding
许多签名方案使用摘要来处理消息，但是否预哈希、如何编码以及验证流程由具体算法规定: Many schemes use message digests, but prehashing, encoding and verification are algorithm-specific. Use established library APIs instead of inventing a hash-then-private-key operation. Security depends on hashes, the signature scheme, randomness or nonces, implementation and key management together, not hashing alone.
存储型与反射型描述数据如何到达页面，DOM型强调客户端不安全处理；这些分类可能交: Stored and reflected describe how data reaches a page; DOM-based emphasizes unsafe client processing. Categories can overlap and cannot simply be ranked by severity. DOM XSS may use server-returned data too. Impact depends on execution context, user permissions and reach; an attacker need not type a complete script into an input box.
普通文本宜用textContent或框架默认转义；属性值要使用安全属性与正确编码: For plain text, prefer textContent or framework escaping. Attribute values need safe attributes and correct encoding; URLs also need protocol checks. Avoid untrusted data in event handlers or script contexts. If rich text is allowed, use a maintained sanitizer. One HTML-escaping function does not protect every location.
单靠删除引号或关键字容易漏掉语法与编码变体，不适合作为主要防线。对数据值应使用参: Removing quotes or keywords can miss syntax and encoding variants, so it is a poor primary defense. Bind data parameters. Concatenating untrusted input before preparing a statement does not provide that protection. Structural elements usually need fixed allowed mappings. Inspect dynamic SQL and concatenation inside stored procedures too.
注入不止 SQL: Injection is not limited to SQL
命令行、LDAP、XPath或模板解释器也可能把不可信数据当作语法解析，但各自防: Shells, LDAP, XPath and template interpreters may also parse untrusted input as syntax, but defenses differ. Prefer interfaces separating structure and parameters, using explicit allowlists where needed. Do not mechanically apply SQL placeholder rules to another interpreter. Ordinary business data is not inherently injection.
为什么密码救不了你: Why knowing the password is unnecessary
攻击者可能无需知道密码，只需诱导浏览器发出带凭证的请求。同源策略主要限制跨源读取: An attacker may only need to induce a browser to send credentials automatically. Same-origin policy limits cross-origin reading and some interactions, not all sending. Forms, images and scripts have method, content-type and browser-policy constraints. Images directly trigger requests such as GET; sensitive state changes should not use GET.
服务端可验证CSRF令牌、Origin等来源信息，并配置合适的SameSite。: Servers can validate CSRF tokens and origins and configure SameSite. Strict, Lax and None differ; Lax still allows certain top-level safe-method navigations. Site and origin are different concepts. Cross-site cookies are not universally absent, and defaults are not sufficient by definition. Bind tokens appropriately to sessions or requests; XSS may still bypass protections.
XSS与SQL注入涉及数据进入了不应成为代码的上下文；CSRF则利用环境自动携带: XSS and SQL injection put data into contexts where it becomes code. CSRF exploits ambient credentials and missing request-intent validation, a different mechanism. Tokens are not absolute proof of real user intention and may be reusable per session rather than single-use. Choose controls after identifying the mechanism.
输入校验、框架安全接口、输出编码、授权和监控各有作用。WAF及CSP可提供额外防: Validation, safe framework APIs, output encoding, authorization and monitoring each contribute. WAFs and CSP can add defenses but do not replace fixing known flaws. Layers may share configuration or implementation weaknesses. Verify actual data-flow coverage rather than equating control count with security.
在正确配置并验证服务身份的前提下，TLS 保护应用数据的机密性与完整性，检测传输: With correct configuration and service authentication, TLS protects application confidentiality and integrity, detects traffic tampering and authenticates the peer service. Certificate-based HTTPS normally authenticates servers, not logged-in users; the website handles those identities. Encryption without identity verification may establish an encrypted connection to an attacker.
HTTPS 不保证网站善意、业务内容真实或终端没有恶意软件，也不必然隐藏通信地址: HTTPS does not certify benevolence, truthful business content or malware-free endpoints. Addresses, timing and lengths may remain visible. Phishing domains can have valid certificates, so check the intended domain. Handshakes and encryption cost work, but network, caching and protocols also affect loading; HTTPS is not always faster or slower.
随机数不等于前向保密: Random values are not forward secrecy
握手随机数是公开输入，不会单独产生安全密钥。以临时 (EC)DHE 为例，双方建: Handshake random values are public inputs, not sufficient secrets. Ephemeral (EC)DHE establishes shared secrets and derives directional traffic keys with the handshake transcript. Properly destroyed ephemeral secrets prevent later compromise of long-term authentication keys from decrypting past sessions. Forward secrecy does not protect data whose own traffic keys have leaked.
无额外重试的普通握手通常需 1-RTT，不含 DNS、TCP 建连。恢复可用预共: An ordinary handshake without extra retries usually takes 1 RTT, excluding DNS and TCP setup. Resumption can use PSKs without ECDHE every time. Permitted 0-RTT sends data early but still needs a handshake and lacks ordinary replay protection. An “idempotent” label alone is insufficient; assess real side effects. Without additional information, avoid unsafe methods; servers can require retry using 425.
证书包含公钥、有效期、签发者、服务标识及用途等扩展。DNS 域名按 subjec: Certificates contain public keys, validity, issuer, service identifiers and usage extensions. DNS names are matched against subjectAltName dNSName values under wildcard limits. Clients validate a path to a trusted root, constraints and certificate-status policy. Handshake proof of private-key possession prevents impersonation by merely copying a public certificate.
自签名只能说明签名可由证书自己的公钥验证，不会自动建立外部信任。默认未信任时，浏: A self-signature is verifiable with the certificate's own key but does not establish external trust. Browsers usually warn if it is not trusted. Internal systems can distribute private CA trust anchors through controlled processes, while still checking names and constraints. Disabling validation is not trust configuration, and unknown roots should not be installed casually.
根之所以被信任，来自客户端信任策略，而非自签名本身。站点证书通常经中间 CA 构: Roots are trusted because of client policy, not their self-signatures. Site certificates usually form paths through intermediates to an anchor, checked for signatures, time, CA eligibility and other constraints. One misissued site certificate mainly threatens covered identities; a compromised CA key can affect more. One invalid path does not make every alternative path invalid.
证书本身是公开信息，私钥泄露或证书误签才是需要处置的风险。CRL、OCSP 等可: Certificates are public; leaked private keys and misissuance create risks. CRLs and OCSP report status, but fetching, caching and failure policies affect timeliness. Short lifetimes reduce exposure without replacing needed revocation. Serious CA events may require trust-store changes; browsers do not always know immediately or automatically revoke everything.
HTTP 401表示目标资源缺少有效认证凭证，并要求相应认证挑战；403表示服务: HTTP 401 means the resource lacks valid authentication credentials and requires an appropriate challenge. 403 means the request is understood but refused, for reasons beyond permissions alone. A 404 can hide existence. Correctly denying a logged-in user shows authorization working; incorrect allowance is the risk, not the denial itself.
登录入口易被注意，资源级权限检查却分散在接口、文件及后台操作中。应默认拒绝未明确: Login flows are obvious, while resource checks are scattered across APIs, files and background operations. Deny access unless explicitly allowed; check actor, resource and action server-side each time, including tests for denials. Shared authorization mechanisms reduce omissions only if they have business context, not merely login status.
HttpOnly限制非HTTP脚本接口读取Cookie，Secure限制在安全传: HttpOnly limits reading through non-HTTP script APIs. Secure restricts sending to secure transport. SameSite controls certain cross-site sending conditions. These reduce risk without guaranteeing protection from most XSS or CSRF. Set suitable lifetimes, rotate session IDs on login or privilege changes, and invalidate old credentials when logging out or otherwise needed.
会话常在服务端保存状态；JWT是声明的令牌格式，可以签名或加密，不自动等于完全无: Sessions often store server-side state. JWT is a claims format that can be signed or encrypted, not a guarantee of complete statelessness. Signed-only JWT contents remain readable, so do not put exposed secrets in them. Immediate revocation may use denylists, session versions or state checks, adding server state. Design expiry and refresh for the actual scheme.
核心 RBAC 用用户 → 角色 → 权限组织授权，用户通过获准启用的角色获得权: Core RBAC organizes users → roles → permissions. Users obtain permissions through roles they may activate. Permissions can target resources and operations, simplifying group changes. Audits should examine role assignments, definitions, hierarchies and extra constraints.
不能把 RBAC 理解为只检查角色名，也不能断言它无法表达数据级权限；权限可限定: RBAC is not merely checking a role name, nor is it inherently unable to express data-level rights. Permissions can constrain resources and be combined with access conditions. ABAC evaluates subject, object, action and environment attributes. Department or ownership conditions can also constrain queries. Every access still needs authorization for the actual target and operation.
接口用 /orders/1234 指定资源时，客户端能修改编号。若服务端只校验登: Clients can edit an identifier such as /orders/1234. If the server checks login but not permission for that order, unauthorized access can follow. Sequential IDs are not the root cause. Sharing, delegation and administrative access also need explicit policies, not a universal owner-only assumption.
服务端应在每次访问时检查用户对目标资源及操作的权限。仅允许访问本人数据时，可用: Check user permission for the target and action on every request. For owner-only data, a query such as where id=? and user_id=? can enforce scope; shared access needs its own policy. Unpredictable UUIDs make guessing harder but do not replace authorization. Middleware still needs the concrete resource and action context.
单层防护可能有缺陷，多个措施可分别减少入口、限制权限、保护数据并帮助检测。但它们: One control may fail. Complementary controls reduce entry points, constrain privileges, protect data and support detection. Shared accounts, settings or infrastructure can make several fail together. Analyze common weaknesses, bypass paths and recovery. Attackers are not guaranteed to traverse every layer or be detected.
网络分段、应用校验与授权、数据保护、监控和恢复各有作用，具体组合应按系统资产及威: Segmentation, validation, authorization, data protection, monitoring and recovery serve different purposes. Choose their combination for assets and threats. Logs mainly detect and trace rather than block access; encryption does not replace authorization. Check real-path coverage, not a fixed layer count or universal checklist.
专用低权限账号通常能减少服务被攻破后可直接操作的资源，但若能访问高权限凭证、敏感: Dedicated low-privilege accounts usually reduce directly accessible resources, but exposed privileged credentials, sensitive APIs or escalation flaws can widen damage. Review file, database, network and management access. Non-root containers alone do not guarantee isolation; capabilities and host configuration matter.
按实际任务授予数据库表和操作权限，将迁移或管理能力与日常服务分开；对象存储限制到: Grant database tables and operations by task, separating migration or administrative powers from routine services. Restrict object storage to needed resources and prefer time-limited credentials where suitable. Choose read-only file systems and capability restrictions for the workload. Banning one SQL command or root is not universal protection. Review permissions and credential exposure continuously.
根据风险记录认证、授权变更、敏感访问及管理操作，并包含必要的时间、主体、对象、结: Record authentication, permission changes, sensitive access and administration according to risk, with necessary time, actor, target, result and correlation IDs. Assess trustworthiness and need for source IPs. Avoid passwords, access tokens and complete sensitive data. Encode untrusted fields so newlines cannot forge records.
日志应便于集中检索，统一时间口径，限制读取和修改，并设计保留、容量和故障处理。告: Support central search, consistent time, controlled reading and editing, retention, capacity and failure handling. Tune alert thresholds to normal traffic and ensure response ownership. Logs without real-time alerts can still aid investigation. Test collection, search and recovery instead of merely installing tools without usable evidence.
盐应为每次密码存储独立随机生成，并与摘要、算法和成本参数一起保存；更换密码通常也: Generate independent random salts for each password storage event and retain them with digest, algorithm and cost settings; password changes normally get new salts. Salts are not secrets. They weaken cross-record precomputation and comparison advantages without preventing weak-password guesses. Attackers can still try multiple records in parallel.
为什么用慢哈希: Why password hashes should be costly
普通快速哈希不适合作为唯一密码存储方案。Argon2id等可增加内存和时间成本，: A plain fast hash is insufficient as the sole password-storage design. Argon2id can impose memory and time costs; bcrypt mainly adjusts computation. Their parameters differ. Use established libraries, choose settings around hardware, concurrency and login latency, and plan upgrades. No fixed guessing rate, cost factor or complete resistance to specialized hardware is guaranteed.
